 Mr. Souvik Ganguly

 Mr. Pannalal Bandyopadhyay
 Ms. Debdooti Dutta
 ... for the State
 1.

By filing the instant writ petition the writ petitioner  has prayed for issuance of appropriate writ/writs  against the respondent authorities more specifically against the respondent no.4 commanding him to grant land loser certificate for exempted category in the name of the writ petitioner from the date of land acquisition, i.e., in the year 2009-10 as per notification dated 21.08.2002.
2.

In course of hearing, Mr. Ganguly, learned advocate duly led by Mr. Rajendra Banerjee, learned advocate appearing on behalf of the writ petitioner at the very outset draws attention of this court to page no.47 of the instant writ petition being a copy of the land loser certificate under exempted category as issued in the name of the writ petitioner by the respondent no.4 authority.
3. Drawing attention to page no.34 of the instant writ petition, it is submitted that the writ petitioner applied for the said certificate on 04.06.2018.

However, from the copy of the said certificate (page 47 of the instant writ petition), it would reveal that the date of registration of the said certificate has been mentioned as 19.09.2024, as a result of whereof the writ petitioner loses his seniority in terms of the provision of Clause 3(3) of the said notificatation dated 21.08.2002.

4. Mr. Bandyopadhyay, learned advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent State in course of hearing has filed a written instruction dated 26.03.2025 as prepared by the said Land Acquisition Officer, Murshidabad.

From the said report it reveals that it is the case of the respondent authorities that the writ petitioner applied for land loser certificate on 08.02.2023 as per order of a Co-ordinate Bench of this High Court while disposing of WPA 21773 of 2022.

It is the further case of the respondent State that after hearing and considering the prayer of the writ petitioner, the application Snehasis Das vs The State Of West Bengal And Others on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140407507/
1 of the writ petitioner was forwarded to the Labour Department for consideration and from page no.24 and 25 of the report as filed today it would reveal that the writ petitioner's name is enlisted under Serial No.17 for obtaining land loser certificate for the month of July, 2024.
5.

sentences.text: At this juncture, this court proposes to look to the Notification No.301-EMP/IM-10/2000 dated 21st August, 2002.

Clause 3 of the said notification dated 21.08.2002 is quoted hereinbelow in verbatim:
"3. Persons belonging to the families of Land Loser: (1) For the purpose of enlistment of eligible persons of this category the Government may constitute a screening committee for a District/Sub- Division.
The Screening Committee will prepare a combined list in order of priority for families affected by acquisition of land and forward the same to the District Magistrate concerned.
Till such Committee is formed the District Magistrate concerned will prepare the list of eligible persons of this category.
(2) Only one member of a family of land loser will be eligible for consideration for enlistment in the exempted category.
The beneficiary should be either an awardee of compensation for acquisition of land or a member of his family as may be nominated by the awardee.
(3) The order of priority in the list will be determined by the date of acquisition in chronological order.

(4) The priority list should contain the name of the persons seeking employment, the nature and quantum of land acquired and quantum of land owned by the family, the employment status and earnings of the members of the family.
The date of birth, educational standard of the enlisted person should be indicated in the list.
If any such person belongs to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes or Backward Classes that should be indicated against his name.
In case of persons with disabilities the nature of disabilities may also be indicated.
(5) In case of any doubt regarding the eligibility of a person and/or other connected issue reference may be made to the Labour Department for clarification and/or decision.

(6) The District Magistrate concerned will forward the list of eligible persons to the Director of Employment, West Bengal and advise the enlisted persons to enroll their names in the Exempted Category Cell of the Directorate of Employment, West Bengal, at 67, Bentinck Street, Kolkata-700069, by producing supporting papers.

List of eligible persons of the category of land losers already prepared and maintained by the District Magistrates in terms of the earlier circulars issued by the Labour Department shall also be forwarded to the Director of Employment, West Bengal.
The District Magistrate concerned, shall advise such enlisted persons to get their names enrolled in the Exempted Category Cell of the Directorate of Employment by producing supporting papers.

sentences.text:
(7) The Director of Employment, West Bengal, will maintain the list of eligible persons belonging to the exempted category of land losers as enrolled in the Exempted Category Cell along with the lists of eligible persons included in other exempted categories."
6. On careful consideration of the entire materials including Clause 3 of the said notification as placed before this court, it appears that it is incumbent on the part of the screening committee and in absence of such committee upon the District Magistrate to prepare the list of eligible persons under land losers category and in such list the order of priority would be determined by the date of acquisition in chronological order.
7.

From the report as submitted on behalf of the State, this court finds no materials that either the District Magistrate or the relevant committee had prepared the list in chronological order by the date of acquisition.

It further appears to this court that in page nos.24 and 25 of the report as submitted today, there is no column indicating "the actual date of acquisition".
8.

In view of such this court directs the District Magistrate, Murshidabad to submit a report in writing positively on or before the adjourned day clearly indicating as to how he prepared a combined list in order of priority for families affected by the acquisition of land in terms of Clause 3(1) and (3) of the said notification dated 21.08.2002.
9.
Let the matter be listed on May 13, 2025 for further consideration.

10. Learned counsel for the respondent State hereby requested to supply advance copy of the report as called for to the learned counsel for the writ petitioner preferably three days ahead of the next date of hearing.
11. Learned counsel for the respondent State is further requested to communicate the server copy of this order to the respondent nos.2 and 3 for their information and immediate compliance.
12. All parties are to act on the basis of server copy of the order.

(Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
